description: This shell script is designed to launch a web browser pointing to an HTML page that describes a git command. It handles various browser options, configurations, and platform-specific behaviors to determine and execute the appropriate browser to open a URL/file.

methods.name: valid_custom_tool
methods.description: Checks if a custom browser command is configured via git config.

methods.name: valid_tool
methods.description: Determines if the given tool/browser is valid and supported.

methods.name: init_browser_path
methods.description: Initializes the path to the specified browser by checking git config or default system paths.
